verdict.rationale: Appwrite's own self-hosting docs claim "Full control over data location": you can run it on any Docker-capable OS or your own Kubernetes cluster, and migrate between Appwrite Cloud and self-hosted. That lets a user decide where data lives. Nothing in the pack shows choosing a region or residency option inside the managed Cloud offering, so residency control comes only through running your own infrastructure. Missing for 10: documented Cloud region/residency selection, a list of available regions, and independent corroboration of residency controls.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)

citations.quote: You can install and run Appwrite on any operating system that can run a Docker CLI, or on your own Kubernetes cluster with the official Helm chart.
You can also migrate between Appwrite Cloud and self-hosted.
